description: You are a GIS Security Administrator at a municipal IT department. You must configure role-based access control for the GeoServer instance at http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/ (admin / Admin123!). Complete all of the following: (1) Create a new GeoServer user named 'gis_reader' with password 'GisR3ader2024!'. (2) Create a new GeoServer role named 'ROLE_GIS_READER'. (3) Assign the user 'gis_reader' to the role 'ROLE_GIS_READER'. (4) Create a data security access rule granting ROLE_GIS_READER read access to all layers in the 'ne' workspace (resource pattern: ne.*.r). (5) Create a service security rule allowing ROLE_GIS_READER access to the WMS service.
